This paper is structured as follows. In Section 2, we introduce our notation and give some preliminaries on hyperbolic surface theory and triangulations. In Section 3, we prove our linear upper bound for the number of vertices of a minimal distance Delaunay triangulation. In Section 4, we construct classes of hyperbolic surfaces attaining the order of this linear upper bound.
